_comment: Source registry. 'access' is a recorded permission decision. Nothing marked NOT_CLEARED is ever fetched. No source here is CLEARED and no source is display_cleared: that needs written permission, recorded in clearance_evidence/display_evidence. Terms URLs come from PHASE2_FEASIBILITY_REPORT.md (reported terms, not read in full). Schedules: market_hours = hourly in NSE/BSE sessions only; daily = once per IST day at daily_time (off-hours); local = local files only.

sources.name: Operator-supplied files (inbox/INBOX/*.csv)
sources.notes: Rows carry their own amount_grade. Not cleared for public display until the operator records display_evidence.

sources.name: NSE website, quote/corporate-action endpoints, archives
sources.notes: Reported terms require written permission to copy/store/redistribute and bar automated collection. No fetcher is implemented.

sources.name: BSE website and APIs
sources.notes: Reported disclaimer bars reproduction/redistribution. No fetcher is implemented.

sources.name: AMFI daily NAV file
sources.notes: Reported terms: personal, non-commercial use; written agreement needed otherwise. No fetcher is implemented.

sources.name: Issuer / AMC filings and disclosures
sources.notes: Per-issuer permissions not established. Disclosed figures may be keyed in via the inbox with their source noted.
